overview.pattern: Modular monolith with multiple local invocation surfaces over one cache-first agent kernel
overview.description: The published library src/index.ts, sole reasonix-legacy CLI src/cli/index.ts, Ink TUI src/cli/ui/App.tsx, ACP adapter src/cli/commands/acp.ts, and messaging commands all compose CacheFirstLoop from src/loop.ts; the loop does not depend on those surfaces.

data-flow:interactive.flow: reasonix-legacy argv -> src/cli/index.ts -> src/cli/commands/code.tsx or chat.tsx -> src/cli/ui/App.tsx -> src/loop.ts -> src/client.ts and src/tools.ts -> TUI events
data-flow:interactive.description: Code mode builds workspace-rooted capabilities in src/code/setup.ts before creating the immutable model prefix in src/memory/runtime.ts.

data-flow:headless.flow: QQ/Telegram/Weixin command -> src/cli/headless/host.ts -> src/cli/headless/turn-driver.ts -> src/loop.ts -> provider channel
data-flow:headless.description: Transport-neutral loop construction is shared in src/cli/headless/host.ts while protocol and access rules remain in src/qq/, src/telegram/, and src/weixin/.

data-flow:acp.flow: stdin NDJSON -> src/acp/server.ts -> src/cli/commands/acp.ts -> src/core/eventize.ts -> src/acp/dispatch.ts -> stdout JSON-RPC
data-flow:acp.description: ACP is a process protocol surface with session-scoped tools, gates, loop state, and event projection; it does not open an HTTP listener.

conventions.naming: Ordinary modules use kebab-case, React components use PascalCase, functions use camelCase, and exported types/classes use PascalCase (src/context-manager.ts, src/cli/ui/App.tsx).
conventions.file-organization: Composition lives in src/cli/, orchestration in src/loop.ts and src/loop/, model-callable capabilities in src/tools.ts and src/tools/, protocol clients in src/mcp/ and src/acp/, durable state in src/memory/ and src/transcript/.
conventions.imports: The repository is ESM; TypeScript relative imports use .js suffixes, deep CLI imports may use @/*, and ink resolves to packages/ink/src/index.ts (package.json, tsconfig.json).

component:PublicPackage.responsibility: Defines reasonix-legacy@1.3.1, the sole public reasonix-legacy bin, the src/index.ts library bundle contract, and packages/* workspace discovery.

component:LibraryAPI.responsibility: Exports the supported model client, loop, tools, memory, transcript, MCP, repair, configuration, version, and telemetry APIs.

component:CLI.responsibility: Applies startup/proxy guards and lazily routes the reasonix-legacy command tree to interactive, one-shot, ACP, channel, diagnostic, MCP, session, and index handlers.

component:AgentKernel.responsibility: Owns streaming model/tool iteration, healing, hooks, cancellation, reasoning retention, context pressure, and usage events.

component:ContextPolicy.responsibility: Estimates fold economics and folds append-only conversation history while preserving active constraints and model/tool pairings.

component:CapabilityRegistry.responsibility: Normalizes tool schemas, enforces plan and confirmation policy, rate limits and cancellation, dispatches implementations, and bounds model-facing results.

component:CodeToolset.responsibility: Registers workspace-rooted filesystem, shell, memory, planning, query, skill, subagent, web, job, and optional semantic capabilities.

component:ModelAdapter.responsibility: Calls DeepSeek-compatible chat completions, model listing, and balance endpoints with SSE streaming and retry/error handling.

component:EventKernel.responsibility: Transforms operational loop events into redacted typed events consumed by reducers, ACP, headless channels, and JSONL adapters.

component:MCP.responsibility: Implements MCP JSON-RPC over stdio, SSE, and Streamable HTTP; src/mcp/registry.ts bridges discovered tools into ToolRegistry.

component:TUIRuntime.responsibility: Provides the repository-owned React Reconciler/Yoga terminal renderer used by src/cli/ui/.

component:SharedUtilities.responsibility: Exports pure compaction, prefix, path display, tool-kind, and approval-prompt utilities shared by root surfaces.

persistence.pattern: Local append-oriented files with atomic metadata/config writes
persistence.description: Sessions use JSONL under user storage in src/memory/session.ts, semantic vectors use project-local JSONL/JSON in src/index/semantic/store.ts, and atomic writes are implemented in src/core/atomic-write.ts.

security.pattern: Configuration-scoped credentials, access gates, permission pauses, and event redaction
security.description: Endpoint/key pairing is centralized in src/config.ts, bot authorization lives in src/qq/access.ts, src/telegram/access.ts, and src/weixin/access.ts, tool confirmations use src/core/pause-gate.ts, and event output is filtered by src/core/event-redaction.ts.

build-and-release.pattern: Two tsup ESM bundles with Windows release gates
build-and-release.description: tsup.config.ts emits dist/index.js and dist/cli/index.js; package.json post-build scripts add the CLI package marker and tree-sitter grammars; .github/workflows/ci.yml and publish-npm.yml gate Node 24.15.0/npm 11.16.0 Windows builds and publish only reasonix-legacy.
